title: Create Worker Pool
description: Creates a new WorkerPool in a given project and location.

objective.narrative: A WorkerPool is a top-level container that manages a set of configurations and revision templates which implement a pull-based workload. It helps to encapsulate software lifecycle decisions such as rollout policy and team resource ownership for pull-based workloads.
